---
title: "Reproducibility"
---

## Version lock

The first published cases were executed locally with:

- R 4.5.1
- SCOP 0.8.9
- Seurat and ggplot2 from the installed environment
- Quarto 1.10.18 for site rendering
- Synthetic, repository-owned inputs generated with fixed random seeds

The live upstream reference may describe a different release. Every case page therefore states its target version, and the build records the current site commit separately from the analysis identity.

## Evidence manifests

Each complete case stores a JSON manifest containing:

- case name and scope
- data dimensions and seed
- package versions
- workflow functions
- result summary
- generated figure path and SHA-256 hash
- known limitations

These manifests are not a substitute for study-level provenance; they make the tutorial claim auditable.

## Build policy

- Lightweight static content is rendered in GitHub Actions.
- The case scripts are run deliberately and their outputs are reviewed before publication.
- Heavy or optional backends are labeled when not rerun by the Pages build.
- No CI job downloads private data or depends on an absolute local path.
- A site release is traceable to a Git commit and a Quarto version.

## Re-run locally

```bash
Rscript scripts/single-cell-case.R
Rscript scripts/spatial-case.R
quarto render
```

Inspect the actual PNGs and the generated HTML before pushing `main`.
